Serajuddin Hossain
2016-12-10T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/serajuddin-hossain-1327846

Today is the 45th anniversary of abduction of martyred journalist Serajuddin Hossain, a former executive and news editor of the daily Ittefaq. On this day in 1971, Pakistani occupation army and their collaborators abducted him from his Chamelibagh residence in Dhaka and he never returned. A milad mahfil will be held at his Mohammadpur residence. Programmes will also be held at his Sharushuna village in Magura and Shaheed Serajuddin Hossain College in Jessore, says a press release.
